newsitem.title: UK: Chilean central banker sees no near-term rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Chilean central banker sees no near-term rate cut.

text.p: Pablo Pinera, a director of the Chilean Central Bank, said on Thursday he did not expect there would an interest rate cut in the near term.
"If we see figures are consistent with our target we don't have any problem to reduce interest rates, but we don't see that in the near future," Pinera told Reuters.

Speaking after an investor presentation in London, he said, "Each month, we see all the economic figures and then we take the decision. But we never know in advance when we are going to reduce, or not, the interest rate."
There had been speculation in markets of a cut soon.
